summary: The legal tree always has exactly three nodes and each node has one of 201 values, so the complete source domain is fixed and offers no honest asymptotic size axis.

workload_bound.source_constraint: the tree has exactly a root and two children, and every value is from -100 through 100

replacement_checks.evidence: The reference reads the fixed root and two child values, performs one addition, and performs one equality comparison.
Regression covers all 40,401 child-value pairs with every legal equality root, adjacent false roots, and root-value boundaries.
